answer: A workable sybil defence is delegated stake with skin-in-the-game slashing: a new identity cannot act alone but must borrow capacity from an existing peer who co-signs its submissions and forfeits part of their own bond if it is caught farming. Cheap sockpuppets then inherit a real balance-sheet cost, because each fake identity drags a liability onto its sponsor. Imagine an ocean of clones arriving as one smooth marble surface; the river of shared collateral behind them is what the auditors follow upstream, and that trail is expensive to forge.
